**Publish gate report**

**Going out:** Product page copy for the peppermint tea, UK, public.

**Claims**
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Just peppermint leaves, nothing else." | Product fact (ingredients), fine as written |
| "Cool and clean after a big meal." | Describes taste and feel, not a health outcome. It makes no digestive or other benefit claim. |
| "Certified organic by the Soil Association." | On the policy list, exact wording. Certificate on file, renewed 2026. |

**Regulated claims:** Nothing on health, money, environment, children or prices. "Cool and clean after a big meal" is the one line to watch. It stays acceptable as long as nobody expands it to "aids digestion", "settles your stomach" or similar, which the policy bans.

**House style:** About 95/100. The tone is warm, plain and unhurried. It uses no banned words and has none of the AI tells (no stock openers, reversals or slogan closers).

**Disclosure:** None needed. This is the brand's own product page with no ad, affiliate, gifted or AI-label trigger.

**Fixed:** Nothing. No changes were needed.

**Needs a decision:** Nothing unresolved.

**Approver:** Sam (marketing lead). I haven't recorded any approval. Sam needs to give an explicit yes to this exact copy before it goes live, and any edit after that means a new check.
